title: Six-arrow normalization of the factorized integral scalar morphism
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite-field datum $D$ with $\ell\ne D.p$, finite-type schemes $X,Y$ over $D.k$, a separated finite-type relative morphism $f:X\to Y$, its compactification $c$, a coefficient construction $P$, and a StageAction [def-sf-locally-finite-adic-compact-support-data, def-sf-constructible-exceptional-coefficient-construction-data, def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Fix realizations source and target [def-sf-locally-finite-adic-realization-data] and a finite coefficient index $E$. Let $s_X,s_Y$ be maps from the completed integral coefficient ring sheaves to the native ring sheaves, equal to the integral maps of source and target. For any natural transformation $\beta:P_{\mathrm{completed}}\circ C_Y\to C_X\circ P_{\mathrm{native}}$ in the functor-composition convention of Lean, with $C_T$ derived extension along $s_T$ and $P$ the actual compact-support image [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data], construct a natural transformation $\tau$ between the native finite-stage compact-support functors after integral-to-rational localization [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. On every finite-Tor integral input $K$ [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], the section component of $\tau$ factors as $b_K\,\beta_K\,d_K$ with both outer factors isomorphisms. Its six-arrow component formula has, in order, the recorded rationalLeft arrow, the target integral realization, derived extension of inverse sfQcqsCompactSupportRealization, the supplied $\beta_K$, compact support of the inverse source integral realization, and inverse operationTransport. No invertibility of $\beta$ is assumed. In particular, taking $\beta$ to be the recorded proper/open scalar mate gives exactly the parent's original normalization.

theorem native_integral_scalar_morphism_normalization [G : NativeGeometry.{u} l]
    (source : Realization l X) (target : Realization l Y)
    (stage : StageAction l D hl P c) (E : Index l (PadicAlgCl l))
    (sx : (PurCompactSupport.completed l (Coefficient l (PadicAlgCl l) E)).ring X ⟶
      (nativeCoefficients l).ring X)
    (sy : (PurCompactSupport.completed l (Coefficient l (PadicAlgCl l) E)).ring Y ⟶
      (nativeCoefficients l).ring Y)
    (hs : sx = (source.coefficient E).integralMap l X)
    (ht : sy = (target.coefficient E).integralMap l Y)
    (beta : PurCompactSupport.image (PurCompactSupport.completed l
        (Coefficient l (PadicAlgCl l) E)) c ⋙ pbcDerivedExtend sy ⟶
      pbcDerivedExtend sx ⋙ PurCompactSupport.image (nativeCoefficients l) c) :
    ∃ tau : sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l
        (Coefficient l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X ⋙
        (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
          (l := l) (Ω := PadicAlgCl l) (Y := X) E ⋙ stage.system.functor ⋙ target.J) ⟶
      sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l
        (Coefficient l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X ⋙
        (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
          (l := l) (Ω := PadicAlgCl l) (Y := X) E ⋙ source.J ⋙ actual l c),
      ∀ K : finiteTorConstructibleIntegralCategory l
          (Coefficient l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X,
        (∃ (b : (sections l Y).mapDerivedCategory.obj
              ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l
                (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X ⋙
                (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
          (l := l) (Ω := PadicAlgCl l) (Y := X) E ⋙ stage.system.functor ⋙ target.J)).obj
                  ((PurCompactSupport.finiteTorIntegralInclusion l
                    (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X).obj K)) ≅
            (PurCompactSupport.image (PurCompactSupport.completed l
              (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E)) c ⋙
              pbcDerivedExtend sy).obj K.obj)
          (d : (pbcDerivedExtend sx ⋙
              PurCompactSupport.image (nativeCoefficients l) c).obj K.obj ≅
            (sections l Y).mapDerivedCategory.obj
              ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l
                (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X ⋙
                (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
          (l := l) (Ω := PadicAlgCl l) (Y := X) E ⋙ source.J ⋙ actual l c)).obj
                  ((PurCompactSupport.finiteTorIntegralInclusion l
                    (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X).obj K))),
          (sections l Y).mapDerivedCategory.map
              (tau.app ((PurCompactSupport.finiteTorIntegralInclusion l
                (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X).obj K)) =
            b.hom ≫ beta.app K.obj ≫ d.hom) ∧
    let rationalInput :=
      (rationalization l (ULift.{u} (PadicAlgCl l)) (finiteField l E) X).obj K
    let input := (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
        (l := l) (Ω := PadicAlgCl l) (Y := X) E).obj rationalInput
    ∃ (A B : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l
          (Coefficient l (PadicAlgCl l) E) Y) (r : A ⟶ B),
      HEq r ((P.ring.rationalLeft c (finiteField l E)).hom.app rationalInput) ∧
    ∃ (M₁ M₂ M₃ M₄ M₅ : DerivedCategory
          (proEtaleRingModules Y (ringSheaf l Y)))
      (a₀ : (sections l Y).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l
          (Coefficient l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X ⋙
          (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
          (l := l) (Ω := PadicAlgCl l) (Y := X) E ⋙ stage.system.functor ⋙ target.J)).obj
            ((PurCompactSupport.finiteTorIntegralInclusion l
              (Coefficient l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X).obj K)) ⟶ M₁)
      (a₁ : M₁ ⟶ M₂) (a₂ : M₂ ⟶ M₃) (a₃ : M₃ ⟶ M₄) (a₄ : M₄ ⟶ M₅)
      (a₅ : M₅ ⟶ (sections l Y).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l
          (Coefficient l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X ⋙
          (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
          (l := l) (Ω := PadicAlgCl l) (Y := X) E ⋙ source.J ⋙ actual l c)).obj
            ((PurCompactSupport.finiteTorIntegralInclusion l
              (Coefficient l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X).obj K))),
      HEq a₀ ((sections l Y).mapDerivedCategory.map
        (target.J.map ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
          (l := l) (Ω := PadicAlgCl l) (Y := Y) E).map r))) ∧
      HEq a₁ ((target.integral E).hom.app
          ((sfCompactSupportFiniteIntegralFunctor l D.k
            (PurCompactSupport.coefficientPrimeUnit l D hl) c
            (Coefficient l (PadicAlgCl l) E)).obj
              ((PurCompactSupport.finiteTorIntegralInclusion l
                (Coefficient l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X).obj K))) ∧
      HEq a₂ ((pbcDerivedExtend ((target.coefficient E).integralMap l Y)).map
          ((sfQcqsCompactSupportRealization l (Coefficient l (PadicAlgCl l) E)
            D.k (PurCompactSupport.coefficientPrimeUnit l D hl) c).inv.app
              ((PurCompactSupport.finiteTorIntegralInclusion l
                (Coefficient l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X).obj K))) ∧
      HEq a₃ (beta.app K.obj) ∧
      HEq a₄ ((PurCompactSupport.image (nativeCoefficients l) c).map
          ((source.integral E).inv.app
            ((PurCompactSupport.finiteTorIntegralInclusion l
              (Coefficient l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X).obj K))) ∧
      HEq a₅ ((operationTransport l c).inv.app (source.J.obj input)) ∧
      (sections l Y).mapDerivedCategory.map
          (tau.app ((PurCompactSupport.finiteTorIntegralInclusion l
            (Coefficient l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X).obj K)) =
        a₀ ≫ a₁ ≫ a₂ ≫ a₃ ≫ a₄ ≫ a₅

statement_change.old_statement: Fix the data of lem-sf-native-integral-scalar-morphism, a finite coefficient index E, a natural morphism tau as in lem-sf-native-integral-scalar-morphism-existence, and its b/comparison/d component factorization on every finite-Tor integral input. For each such K, the component of tau satisfies the six-arrow IntegralComponent formula with the prescribed rationalLeft arrow, target and source integral realizations, pbcDerivedExtend, PurCompactSupport.comparison, and operationTransport.
statement_change.what: Arbitrary outer factors b and d do not determine the canonical six-arrow composite. In the additive setting, replacing tau and b by their negatives preserves the factorization hypothesis; the prescribed canonical arrows do not acquire that sign. At an identity compactification on a nonzero rank-one characteristic-zero coefficient object the two composites differ. Replace the universal assertion about an arbitrary tau by a direct construction of a normalized tau with the same factorization and component formula. The parent statement is unchanged. The repaired constructor is proved for any scalar natural transformation beta with these endpoints; the caller specializes beta to the recorded compact-support comparison.
